commands.name: sdk demo build
commands.usage: haiven sdk demo build unity-bossroom|unreal-lyra --sdk-root path --sdk-revision commit --target linux64|win64|osx [--dest path] [--out path] [unity-bossroom: [--unity path] [--timeout seconds]] [unreal-lyra: [--engine path] [--content path] [--item code=item]... [--editor-only]]
commands.summary: Build Boss Room or Lyra from a development SDK checkout. Use the native editor to build standalone demo checkouts.

commands.name: sdk demo open
commands.usage: haiven sdk demo open unity-bossroom|unreal-lyra|godot-demo --sdk-root path --sdk-revision commit [--no-editor] [unity-bossroom: [--unity path]] [unity-bossroom development checkout: --api-root path [--dest path] [--backend local-api|wsfixture|auto] [--oauth]] [unreal-lyra: [--engine path] [--dest path] [--content path] [--item code=item]...] [godot-demo: [--godot path]]
commands.summary: Open a pinned Boss Room, Lyra, or Godot demo in its editor.

commands.name: sdk demo register
commands.usage: haiven sdk demo register unity-bossroom --sdk-root path --sdk-revision commit [--dest path] [--hub-cli command]
commands.summary: Add a pinned Boss Room project to Unity Hub.

commands.name: sdk fake-server
commands.usage: haiven sdk fake-server [--addr host:port] [--token VALUE:USER[:expired|:invalid]]... [--route type]... [--rate-limited type]... [--deferred type]... [--record file.jsonl] [--ready-file file.json]
commands.summary: Serve a local model of the gaming WebSocket (/v0/ws) with control levers, until interrupted.

commands.name: sdk starter create
commands.usage: haiven sdk starter create <starter> --dest path [--preview] [--yes] [--param name=value]...
commands.summary: Optionally preview or automate sample creation without replacing the native guide.

commands.name: sdk starter describe
commands.summary: Describe a trusted starter and its normative native onboarding guide.

commands.name: sdk starter integrate
commands.usage: haiven sdk starter integrate <starter> --project path [--preview] [--yes] [--param name=value]...
commands.summary: Optionally preview or automate native onboarding in a clean Git worktree. A changed starter lock is refused.

commands.name: sdk starter list
commands.usage: haiven sdk starter list [--engine name] [--journey name] [--platform name] [--feature name]
commands.summary: List trusted SDK starters with immutable native guides and stable manual steps.

commands.name: sdk starter run
commands.usage: haiven sdk starter run <starter> --project path [--param name=value]...
commands.summary: Build and run a supported demo through its verified SDK-owned lifecycle runner.

commands.name: sdk starter verify
commands.usage: haiven sdk starter verify --project path [--starter id]
commands.summary: Verify locked or native/manual onboarding; pending guide steps are never success.
